rationale: Only WebGL LED lighting ignores an elevation added on the 2.0.0 line; the stable flat and legacy 2.5D light fields are unchanged.

summary.ru: Свет LED-лент на полу и стенах в 3D учитывает заданную высоту; при пустом поле остаётся прежним.
summary.en: 3D LED light on the floor and walls follows the configured height; Auto keeps the previous lighting.
